name: rpi_uhat_header
title: Raspberry Pi 40-pin header (uHAT)
purpose: Socket onto a Pi Zero's 40-pin header, and the uHAT mounting holes

sources.title: Raspberry Pi GPIO pinout diagram (official documentation)
sources.read: pin numbers of 3V3, 5V, GND, GPIO2/3, GPIO14/15, GPIO0/1, GPIO17/22/23/27

sources.title: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W mechanical drawing and product brief
sources.read: drawing: holes 58 x 23 mm, header centre 29 mm from the left hole, pin 1 square pad at the left end, inner row

sources.title: Raspberry Pi uHAT board mechanical drawing
sources.read: drawing: 65 x 30 mm, holes 3.5 mm from edges, 2.75 mm drill, 6.2 mm land

sources.title: KiCad footprint Module:Raspberry_Pi_Zero_Socketed_THT_FaceDown_MountingHoles
sources.read: pad 1 at (0,0), pad 39 at (0, 48.26); holes 2.75 mm at x -1.27 / 21.73, y -4.87 / 53.13 (58 x 23 mm), the header centred between them

parts.quote: 40-pin header, 2.54 mm pitch (kicadpizero: 2x20, 2.54mm pitch); pin numbers as the official pinout: 3V3 1/17, 5V 2/4, GND 6/9/14/20/25/30/34/39; socket on the board's underside, onto the Pi's header
"MOUNTING HOLES SHOULD BE DRILLED TO 2.75mm +/- 0.05mm" (2.7 mm is the drawing's lower limit); "MOUNTING HOLE LAND SHOULD BE MIN. 6.2mm"
"MOUNTING HOLES SHOULD BE DRILLED TO 2.75mm +/- 0.05mm" (2.7 mm is the drawing's lower limit); "MOUNTING HOLE LAND SHOULD BE MIN. 6.2mm"
"MOUNTING HOLES SHOULD BE DRILLED TO 2.75mm +/- 0.05mm" (2.7 mm is the drawing's lower limit); "MOUNTING HOLE LAND SHOULD BE MIN. 6.2mm"
"MOUNTING HOLES SHOULD BE DRILLED TO 2.75mm +/- 0.05mm" (2.7 mm is the drawing's lower limit); "MOUNTING HOLE LAND SHOULD BE MIN. 6.2mm"

+5V.note: pins 2 and 4; the board back-powers the Pi here (hatguide: "supplying 5V through the GPIO header pins 2,4 and GND")

+3V3.note: the Pi's 3.3 V, pins 1 and 17; never a source into it (hatguide: "Under no circumstances should a power source be connected to the GPIO header 3.3V pins")

/I2C_SDA.note: GPIO2, pin 3; the Pi has ~2 kΩ pull-ups (hatplus p4)

/ID_SD.note: GPIO0, pin 27: only the ID EEPROM (hatplus p5)

layout.rules: uhatmech: board 65 x 30 mm, 3 mm corner radius, holes 3.5 mm from the edges (58 x 23 mm); zero2w: header centred 29 mm from the left hole (x 32.5), its rows either side of the holes' line (y 3.5), pin 1 at the left end on the inner row. J1 is placed so pin 1 lands at (8.37, 4.77): 32.5 - 24.13 (half of pin 1 to pin 39, 48.26 mm, kicadpizero).

open_questions: The pin 1 position and orientation after the back-side flip must be checked on the generated board (pad 1 at x 8.37, y 4.77; pad 2 at y 2.23).
uhatmech wants the header 30.5 mm board height with an SMT header, 30 mm otherwise; this is a through-hole socket: 30 mm.
